subject: Pilot scope and ownership — Stellarnet (next steps)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@stellarnet.ai>, Maya Chen <maya@stellarnet.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stellarnet pilot — recap & proposed next steps

Hi Evan / Maya — great talk today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a suggested, lightweight kickoff plan so we can align on owners and access.

High-level pain / goal we heard
- Live product latency and hallucination rates on domain Q&A (support KB) — wanting consistent under-100ms median and <5% hallucination on our prompt-eval suite.
- Need a way to offload inference costs for spikes while keeping PII controls in place.

Proposed pilot scope (2-week initial sprint)
- Dataset: 5k transit support examples + 500 labeled edge-cases (we discussed sampling).
- Success metrics: median latency <=100ms (95th <500ms), hallucination rate <5% on our eval set, and token cost under $0.004 per request (approx).
- Deliverables: hosted test endpoint, prompt set + eval matrix, weekly sync + 1 post-run findings doc.

Owners / contacts
- Customer technical: Evan Brooks (Stellarnet) — access + dataset owner
- Redwood technical lead: Monica Patel — integration, env setup
- Redwood infra lead: Karthik Iyer — network, service account, allowlist
- Commercial/POC: Priyom Das — timelines, success criteria, procurement alignment

Initial timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): access + SSO/Okta invite, sample dataset upload, test credentials
- Week 1: baseline run, prompt/eval tuning, latency profiling
- Week 2: final run, handoff recommendations, cost/ops playbook

Immediate access asks
- Okta SAML connector + an admin contact for SSO (we can share a short Okta checklist)
- Small sample dataset (500–1k rows) in CSV to confirm formats
- Allowlist IP ranges (we'll provide ours once infra is confirmed)

Attachments I will share after you confirm: pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv (sample), mvp-eval-matrix.xlsx (metrics + thresholds).

Proposed next steps
1) Evan: confirm Okta admin and preferred staging window (we can accommodate a morning or evening slot for setup).
2) Monica / Karthik: I’ll loop you in for technical kickoffs once Evan confirms SSO contact.
3) Schedule a 30-min kickoff call for Tuesday to finalize access & test credentials.

Thanks again — happy to adjust scope if you want a longer run or to include reranking experiments.

Best,
Priyom

Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stellarnet pilot — recap & proposed next steps

Thanks Priyom — this looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. A few clarifications: 

1) Okta/admin: I’ll ask our identity team to generate the connector details. Primary contact is Maya Chen (maya@stellarnet.ai) — she’ll own the SSO flow.
2) Dataset: We can get a 1k-sample CSV by tomorrow morning; full 5k within 3 business days.
3) Can we shorten to a 1-week rapid baseline (if we focus only on QA flows) so we can get numbers to our product council? If that works for you, we can expand later.

We’re OK with a staging window next Tuesday morning. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood needs a service account + IP allowlist or if the SSO-only flow is sufficient for the first run?

Maya — looping you in so we can exchange Okta details.

—Evan
Evan Brooks | Head of Platform Engineering, Stellarnet AI
ev...@stellarnet.ai | +1 (646) 555-1212

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@stellarnet.ai>, Maya Chen <maya@stellarnet.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stellarnet pilot — recap & proposed next steps

Thanks Evan — rapid 1-week baseline is fine and likely the best way to get product council traction. Adjusted plan below and concrete asks.

Revised plan (1-week baseline)
- Day 0 (kickoff, Tue morning): SSO connector + sample CSV upload (1k).
- Day 1–2: baseline run on sample set, collect latency + hallucination metrics, light prompt/temperature tuning.
- Day 3: deliver initial results + short readout for product council.

Concrete ask: For the baseline we need either
A) Okta connector + one admin test user OR
B) If you prefer not to set SSO up yet, a short-lived service account key and IP allowlist will work.

Monica will handle the integration. She’s attaching a short data schema checklist and sample curl for endpoint tests. I’m attaching the initial prompt set and an eval matrix so you can see how we’ll measure hallucination / precision.

Attachments (sent)
- pilot_prompt_set_v1.csv (sample prompt/response pairs)
- mvp-eval-matrix.xlsx (metric thresholds + scoring)
- stellarnet-mip-okta-invite.txt (instructions for your IdP team)

Karthik — can you confirm the IP ranges we’ll need to provide for allowlisting if they go that route? Also — any recommended service-account TTLs for temporary keys?

Evan / Maya — propose Tue 2026-11-03 09:30 PT for the kickoff (30 min). If that works I’ll send calendar invites and a short agenda.

Best,
Priyom

Quick infra notes (internal):
- IP ranges to allowlist for hosted staging: 34.201.12.0/24, 52.15.88.0/24, 18.194.65.0/24 (these are the staging egress ranges we use).
- Service account approach: create a short-lived key (TTL 72 hours) scoped to test-only endpoints. We’ll rotate and revoke after baseline run.
- SSO path preferred — less ops friction — but either works. If they go SSO, we just need the Okta metadata xml and a test admin.

I’ll prepare the allowlist template and a minimal playbook for onboarding (service account creation, key TTL, and network steps). Priyom / Monica — I’ll drop the template into the shared Drive folder and cc you both when done.
